title: Don't bother. Cling wrap is thicker
text:
Don't bother. Cling wrap is thicker. Wow, this is one thin liner!
The liner is white, and comes with 12 plastic, really inexpensive hooks.

You can literally see almost everything through this one. It is truly thin. There is a slight stretch to it...I confess it was so thin, I wanted to see if it would tear easily too. I didn't try super hard though. If you had NOTHING to put up in your shower, this would keep the water inside your tub. But it is not antibacterial, not tjick and sturdy, and likely is not washable.

There is almost no point in buying this item. Either get a real curtain or a thicker liner. The only positive thing I have to say about this is that it wouldn't block the light either.
